scope: Read-only search for the exact public original request digest in fixed request metadata filenames within one observed worker jobs parent and one bounded creation-ID prefix. No unknown request bodies returned except a matching digest record; keep raw search rows private until exact target metadata is validated.
limitations: Prefix narrows candidates only; no filename or time proves request identity.
No result, truncation, refusal or timeout does not prove absence or nonexecution.
process_status alone does not return the original key/digest and cannot establish identity.
Exact matched path metadata/full public request must bind original digest/argv/cwd/empty env and original stdin size/hash before job status is attributed.
